definition: the usual way you think about things
description: A snowy city street at night with orange streetlights, falling snow and a red double-decker bus in the distance. A young woman in a red puffer jacket, white top and black trousers sits in the deep snow on the pavement, laughing, then lies back and makes a snow angel with her arms and legs. Another young woman in a navy hooded parka and black boots sits on the bench inside a glass bus shelter with her arms crossed and a cold, annoyed frown. Bicycles stand locked behind them.

taps.target: the woman at the bus stop

taps.phrase: to lie back in the snow
